issues: 画面顶部是调试大标题，图例和标签 20px 级小字，三幕没有叙事文字
点只有 9px 直径、灰/琥珀/黑三色，簇是随机散点互相重叠，像噪点
终幕数字三色分段，读起来像拼错的色块而不是一个数字
迁徙中没有速度感，三幕的节奏差不多，缺少落定后的停顿
changes: look 换 porcelain 瓷白：Free 雾蓝灰 / Pro 钴蓝（主角）/ Enterprise 深海军蓝，点放大到 20px 实心小珠（顶部受光 + 贴地软影）
叙事标题 84px 每幕换一句（Every dot is 40 customers → Split by plan → Stacked by plan → Total customers），旧句上推出、新句从线下升起
簇改向日葵螺旋紧密排布，簇标签/柱顶数值 60px、套餐名 32px；迁徙中点按速度沿方向拉成胶囊，停下变回圆
终幕数字落位后统一收拢成钴蓝，下方三枚图例 + Each dot ≈ 40 customers 把构成信息留在海报上
时间表 192f：中心向外弹出 → 24f 聚簇 → 62f 成柱 → 100f 自左向右扫成数字 → 64f hold（2% 缓推），每幕后留 14–20f 读标签
issuesEn: A debug title sat at the top, legend and labels were ~20px, and the three acts had no narrative text
Dots were only 9px in grey, amber and black; clusters were random overlapping scatter that read as noise
The final number was split into three colour segments and read like misprinted blocks rather than a number
Migrations had no sense of speed, the three acts had the same pacing, and there were no pauses after landing
changesEn: Porcelain look: Free mist slate, Pro cobalt (protagonist), Enterprise deep navy; dots enlarged to 20px solid beads with top light and a soft contact shadow
An 84px narrative headline changes per act (Every dot is 40 customers, Split by plan, Stacked by plan, Total customers), old lines pushing up and new ones rising from below
Clusters use a tight sunflower-spiral packing with 60px values and 32px plan names; in flight each dot stretches into a capsule along its velocity and rounds off when it stops
Once landed the number unifies into cobalt, and a three-item legend plus 'Each dot ≈ 40 customers' keeps the composition on the poster
192f timeline: dots pop out from the centre, cluster at 24f, stack at 62f, sweep left to right into the number at 100f, then a 64f hold with a 2% push; 14–20f reading pauses after each act
